name: TimeField
description:
TimeInput bound to a `string | null` form field holding `HH:mm`. Pair it with `timeSchema()`
and the same locale, clock and bounds. Unreadable text reaches the form as typed and a time
outside min/max as read, so the schema can say which.
signature: ({ label, hint, warning, optional, required, aside, className, disabled, ...control }: TimeFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Override the locale's clock: 12 (am/pm) or 24.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale: the clock and its am/pm words. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest allowed time.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest allowed time.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt while empty. Default: the format in the locale's clock ("h:mm am").

props.name: popup
props.description: Show the list button (default true). Typing and arrow keys work without it.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Hold seconds (`HH:mm:ss`). Default false.

props.name: size
props.description: The box height, matching DateField.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between suggested times, and between arrow-key steps on the minutes (default 15).

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Explicit times to offer in the list instead of every `step` minutes.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width (R15.6). Default short: a time is about eight characters.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.
